title: Striate Riot
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: One 'east' dirt hit shattered into a glitchy mid-register groove by striate interleaving, then driven into a roaring bassline with FM, ladder-filter squelch and rhythmic tremolo gating. Over 16 cycles the striate count, FM index, filter sweep and gate rate all travel on prime-ish clocks so the loop keeps mutating before it repeats.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  s("east*4").n("<0 2 1 3>/4")
    .striate("<4 6 8 6>/8")
    .speed("<1 1 -1 0.5>").squiz("<0 0 1 2>/8")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1, 9)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(300, 3200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(1, 5)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.12)
    .crush("<16 8 6 12>/8").shape(0.4).distort("<0 0.3>/8")
    .tremolosync("<2 4 8>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.9))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.5").room(0.18)
    .gain(0.9)
)
